settings.heading: Materials
settings.content: 18/8 stainless steel body, vacuum-insulated double wall, copper-plated inner wall, textured powder coat. BPA-free polypropylene cap with a silicone gasket.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Hand wash the body with warm soapy water. The cap and gasket are top-rack dishwasher safe. Don't freeze or microwave.

settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.content: Ships in 1 to 2 business days. Use it for 30 days, and if it doesn't earn a spot in your pack, send it back for free.

settings.label: Insulation
settings.value: Vacuum gap with copper-plated inner wall

settings.label: Lid
settings.value: Leakproof screw cap, one-finger carry loop

settings.question: Can I put it in the dishwasher?
settings.answer: The lid, yes. Hand wash the body so the powder coat lasts.

settings.question: How does the bundle discount work?
settings.answer: Buy two of anything and save 10%. Buy three and save 15%. Colors and sizes can be mixed.

settings.title: Cup lid
settings.text: The steel cap unscrews into a 6 oz cup, so you never pour into a cold mug.

settings.title: Glove-friendly handle
settings.text: Wide enough for a gloved hand and it folds flat against the body.

settings.title: Double steel walls
settings.text: A vacuum gap between two layers of 18/8 steel keeps heat where you put it.

settings.title: Rubber base
settings.text: A grippy boot that keeps the flask quiet and upright on rock.
